verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents creating GPU machines through its API and CLI, plus general programmatic resource management via a REST API and the pspace CLI with API keys. Workloads can run over SSH or through Deployments and Workflows. Monitoring and teardown/deletion are not explicitly documented as API/CLI operations; they are only implied by "programmatically manage resources", and the documented auto-shutdown only stops machines rather than destroying them. Missing for 10: explicit API/CLI docs for machine status monitoring and deletion, an MCP server, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end lifecycle.
